matching: one-to-one Hungarian matching; prediction is correct when Euclidean distance is at most the stated pixel radius

count_protocols.bounded_count: deployment behavior; predictions outside the source image are removed
count_protocols.legacy_padded_count: training-log behavior; predictions in padded regions are counted

calibration_warning: Thresholds are evaluated on the same validation fold used for checkpoint selection and must not be treated as independent-test estimates.
